a.lede: Anthropic has filed to go public as it pursues a potential multitrillion-dollar valuation, reporting $16.3 billion in revenue for the first half of 2026. The company’s filing also warns that its AI safety measures may not prevent catastrophic risks. OpenAI and AI chipmaker Cerebras have also pursued public-market listings
a.title: Anthropic prepares for potential $2 trillion IPO valuation after reporting billions in revenue

b.lede: Early-stage and follow-on investors in the AI lab are already sitting on major paper returns.
b.title: What some of Anthropic’s backers are reportedly worth before its IPO
